interpretation_rules.observed: An explicit value/call/body/byte in retained REA representation; no execution implied. External UI observations are separately catalogued.
interpretation_rules.derived: Relationship or SDK/ABI meaning derived from observed facts; original source names/types remain unverified.
interpretation_rules.inferred: Supported role hypothesis with an unresolved identity/dispatch step.
interpretation_rules.unknown: The positive behavior/internal implementation is unresolved; supporting anchors are leads, not proof or evidence of feature absence.
interpretation_rules.confidence_note: Confidence applies only to the narrow initial_assertion, not feature completeness or runtime fidelity. No numeric probabilities were invented.
interpretation_rules.coverage_note: All 25 investigation questions remain partial or unresolved; no complete end-to-end RE claim is made.
interpretation_rules.source_comparison_rule: Keep question IDs, assertions and initial confidence immutable in the initial freeze. Put later source findings/corrections in a successor comparison keyed by question_id. Unknowns are coverage gaps, not automatically correct negatives. Do not double-count related questions as independent proof.

claims.question: How is a requested folder represented and passed into browsing?
claims.initial_assertion: The recovered parse helper turns a path string into a PIDL with SHParseDisplayName; the recovered browse body takes a PIDL. The UI-to-virtual-dispatch edge is unresolved.
claims.initial_basis: Explicit calls/arguments in Ghidra pseudocode support PIDL transport, without recovering original C++ signatures.
unresolved: Address-bar command to parse helper mapping.
Virtual dispatch target connecting parse and browse.
Special Shell namespace policy.
claims.source_verification_question: Which same-version source functions match these addresses, and how do address input and virtual browse dispatch pass PIDLs?

claims.question: Which owner enumerates folder children?
claims.initial_assertion: Browse directly calls the enumeration helper; the helper binds a Shell folder and invokes COM slots consistent with EnumObjects, IEnumIDList::Next, GetAttributesOf and GetDisplayNameOf.
claims.initial_basis: Direct helper calls are observed; COM method names are derived from x64 SDK slot order.
unresolved: ENUM relationship coverage is partial with six unresolved callees.
The ENUM pseudocode omits a binder out argument; apparent null use is not a demonstrated runtime defect.
All flags/settings and virtual items are not mapped.
claims.source_verification_question: Does same-version source use Shell folder binding/enumeration here, with which flags, out parameters and child iteration conditions?

claims.question: Where do per-item metadata and internal IDs come from?
claims.initial_assertion: The recovered metadata helper combines/clones PIDLs, resolves a filesystem path, queries FindFirstFileW data and returns an increasing item ID; root/query-failure branches populate fallback values.
claims.initial_basis: Ghidra shows ILCombine/ILClone, FindFirstFileW/FindClose, attribute/time/size copies and fallback branches.
unresolved: Exact original data types/class field names.
Meaning and display of unavailable metadata for every Shell item.
Failure fallback is not access-denied UX evidence.
claims.source_verification_question: Which source item structure/helper owns PIDLs, FindData, IDs and root/error fallback, and which fields reach the visible columns?

claims.question: How do enumerated items become visible rows?
claims.initial_assertion: The browse path clears the current list, enumerates, then materializes queued IDs into Unicode ListView insert messages; queue producer/consumer linkage is derived from shared fields.
claims.initial_basis: QUEUE and MATERIALIZE share offsets +0xa80/+0xa88; MATERIALIZE sends 0x104d, interpreted through the SDK as Unicode item insertion.
unresolved: Original queue/container types and ownership.
Threading, final sort application and complete large-list responsiveness.
GROUP helper is not established as the user selection-event handler.
claims.source_verification_question: Which source queue/materialization functions match the addresses, and how are row insertion, grouping, selection and threading sequenced?

claims.question: Which comparison policy and direction are recovered?
claims.initial_assertion: A comparator branches between natural-name, FILETIME and 64-bit size comparisons, uses name fallback on ties and conditionally reverses the result. Natural-name comparison calls StrCmpLogicalW.
claims.initial_basis: Recovered comparator field branches and explicit API calls support the narrow comparison mechanisms.
unresolved: Actual column-click to sort-application handler.
Exact ascending flag, folder priority and final tie order.
Six-row runtime ordering does not establish all locale/type cases.
claims.source_verification_question: Which source sort modes/fields correspond to these branches, how is direction applied, and where are the comparator and folder/tie policies selected?

claims.question: How does browse failure propagate to user-visible state?
claims.initial_assertion: The complete failure-propagation and error-UX path is unknown; HRESULT branches and metadata fallback alone do not establish it.
claims.initial_basis: BIND/ENUM have failure branches; BROWSE pseudocode does not clearly show the final error response.
unresolved: Permission-denied and disappearing-directory behavior.
Which layer preserves/restores prior location/list/history.
Message, beep and error recovery policy.

supplemental_basis: docs/analysis/p1-static-findings.md: supplemental EXE GUID bytes 00000122-0000-0000-c000-000000000046 and SDK IDropTarget/CreateViewObject slot derivation
unresolved: Runtime QueryInterface/event/transfer trace.
DropHandler mode 0 body 0x1401a5340 and alternate branch 0x140179ea0.
Registration/revoke/outgoing-drag ownership, cancellation and full data-format coverage.
